task: CLI M1 quality investigation and V2 M4 plan
summary: Rejected the delivered CLI M1 artifact on evidence: 87.0% frozen frames, an 11.27 s hold, slide-like composition, and a synthetic narration whose captions use character-proportional timing. Confirmed the render and audio paths are faithful and identified engine and fixture causes separately; wrote a reuse-first V2 M4 plan with upstream/license research and a required automated quality gate.

model_evidence.notes: Docs-only investigation and planning in Pi; no code changed, no fixture re-rendered, no model or package download. Hugging Face, PyPI and npm registries were unreachable during the session, so TTS model-weight licenses are recorded as unverified.

items.name: Frozen-frame analysis
items.detail: Analysis succeeded and found 20.433 s frozen of 23.500 s (87.0%), longest hold 11.267 s; the artifact is rejected.

items.name: Per-frame motion analysis
items.detail: Only 5 of 704 frames exceed a 1.0 mean luma delta; 578 frames below 0.05.

items.name: Audio-to-source comparison
items.command: ffmpeg decode to 16 kHz mono + normalized cross-correlation
items.detail: Correlation 0.99999 at lag 0, peak 65.1% FS, no clipped samples, envelope self-correlation <=0.117; audio path is faithful, source quality is the issue.

items.name: Speech pause vs plan timing
items.detail: Plan boundaries match a character-proportion model within 0.12-0.71 s and drift from measured speech onsets by -1.07 to +2.04 s while declaring timing 'actual'.
